name: Ogata Monami
source:
A medical doctor, and relative of [url=/c133921]Ogata Honami[/url].

Naturally, she is quite happy to give the protagonist and his friends advice on illnesses.

She is renowned as a sort of "Flying Doctor", frequently travelling between the islands via helicopter.
